# /etc/systemd/system/venture-owner-research-ceo.service
[Unit]
Description=Autonomous research CEO review (preparation-only)
After=network-online.target venture-control-broker-mtls.service
Requires=venture-control-broker-mtls.service

[Service]
Type=simple
User=venture-ceo
Group=venture-ceo
WorkingDirectory=/usr/local/lib/venture-ceo-level2c
Environment=PYTHONPATH=/usr/local/lib/venture-ceo-level2c
EnvironmentFile=/etc/venture-ceo-level2c.env
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -B -m agents.ceo.hierarchy_research_daemon --config /usr/local/lib/venture-ceo-level2c/artifacts/level2c-ceo/hierarchy-config.json --worker-limit 4
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
PrivateDevices=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true
CapabilityBoundingSet=
ReadWritePaths=/usr/local/lib/venture-ceo-level2c/artifacts/level2c-ceo-r4
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

[Install]
